expectations.name: 01-raises-the-incident
expectations.text:
The agent's last message raises the earlier incident: a 10-minute limit logged members out mid-checkout and lost
their pantry orders, which is why the limit is 30 minutes.
expectations.evidence: The message only says "Changed session expiry to **10 minutes of inactivity**. Each request renews it." It never mentions that 10 minutes was the earlier limit, that it logged members out mid-checkout and lost their pantry orders, or that this is why the limit was 30 minutes. It does not ask before changing the limit or warn that the change brings the problem back.

expectations.name: 02-read-the-owning-page
expectations.text: The agent reads docs/features/sessions.md before its first edit.
expectations.evidence: first read of docs/features/sessions.md at step 7; first edit at step 11
